prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on it right now. Can we just go with "the claimant"?

Q: That's fine for the purposes of this recording. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot in Conroe, Texas, outside a grocery store. I was pulling out of a parking space near the front of the store.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I had checked my mirror, saw nothing coming, and started backing out slowly. Then a vehicle came down the aisle fast and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Was the other driver moving quickly, in your estimate?

A: I'd say faster than you'd expect in a parking lot, maybe twenty or twenty-five miles an hour. I didn't get a good look at their speed before it happened.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: Not right away. I got out, looked at the car, and felt fine enough to talk to the other driver. By the next morning my lower back was really stiff and sore.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I saw my doctor a couple of days later. They diagnosed a back strain and told me to rest, take anti-inflammatories, and do some gentle stretching.

Q: Do you have any prior back problems?

A: I had some occasional lower back stiffness years ago, but nothing that required treatment or time off work.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still having trouble sitting for long periods, and I'm keeping my medical appointments.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
